review.gallery: Six distinct project renders from the Azizi Rose factsheet. The branded facade views, courtyard and room scenes were checked visually. Stock photos and repeated native crops were excluded.
review.location: The Rose-labelled map and all eight journey estimates were inspected in the two-page factsheet. Rose has a separate map and distinct Marina and JLT estimates from Wares.
review.floorPlans: All 126 complete Plot 11 sheets compared using PDF text and OCR of visible area panels. 24 printed differences of 0.01 sq ft. Larger source discrepancies on pages 32, 34, 42 and 45 are preserved. Physical pages 33–34 are two versions of the same stack. The PDF’s historic annotations carry no inventory claim.
